capabilities: Convert indented outlines into Markdown headings
Preview a conversion before applying it
Convert selections, whole notes, outline blocks, or marked blocks
Preserve existing headings, list markers, and task checkboxes
Configure base heading level and spaces per indent
motivation: The README says it is designed for notes that start as quick plain text and need to become structured Markdown.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert rough indented plain-text outlines into structured Markdown headings without rewriting them by hand.
summary: Outline converter that turns plain indented text outlines into Markdown headings, with preview, marked blocks, and rerunnable conversion.
